visual.summary: Visitors' camp level 3: the same as level 2 plus a few flowers and grass.
problems: The bright blue and cyan wool tents clash with the timber-and-stone style: use white, brown or green wool with spruce poles, or striped (two colours) canvas.
The tents are solid stepped wool lumps: give them an open front with a fence pole and a bedroll or carpet inside.
Level 3 barely differs from level 2 (a few flowers): give it its own feature (a market stall with an awning, a horse post with a cart, a washing line).
